text:
Sam (People Ops): micro-feedback pack 10 second copy/paste lines for OKRs, self-reviews, and hiring asks. short so folks actually use them.

Sam (People Ops): OKR ONE-LINER: "Objective: Reduce inference cost for realtime by 15% this quarter. KR: lower per-token infra spend by 15% via batching and quantization."

Sam (People Ops): SELF-REVIEW OPEN: "Two bullets: 1) Top outcome + metric. 2) One blocker + what I did about it."

Sam (People Ops): MANAGER START: "Manager highlight: shipped X (link) and improved Y by Z%. Area: help unblock hiring for A."

Sam (People Ops): HIRING ASK (one line): "Recommend hiring: 1 Senior Infra to finish autoscaler (reason: single-thread bottleneck)."

Nora (Eng Manager): nice and short, pasting into my calendar invite.

Diego (IC): pls add a tone-safe missed-goal variant: "Did not meet Goal X due to Y; shipped partial mitigation and set date for remaining work."

Sam (People Ops): added missed-goal line. pinned to #people-ops-templates.

Ally (Recruiter): can managers include hiring priority level (low/med/high) in the one-liner?

Sam (People Ops): yes: add "(priority: high)" to hiring asks.

Nora (Eng Manager): thanks all ":thumbsup:"
